title: Real-Time Uncertainty-Aware Motion Planning for Magnetic-Based Navigation
authors: A. Penumarti; H. Ramos; K. Waters; K. Brink; J. Shin
key_contribution: Meets all SLR inclusion criteria for GPS-denied localization/navigation algorithm and platform validation.
